svg.title: A histogram of the null AUC that builds up over 10000 shuffles of the keep labels within each layer. It centres near 0.523. A vertical line marks the observed AUC of 0.475, inside the bulk of the null.
svg.text: The observed AUC sits inside its null
Bars: the AUC after shuffling keep and fail within each layer, as a share of the shuffles so far.
Line: the observed AUC, 0.475. Two-sided p = 0.21.
AUC: P(the Fisher percentile of a pole that keeps > that of a pole that fails)
